events.reason: Ictus takes the near district before anyone else breathes.
Aquila maps the west side while the others crowd the middle.
Velox runs the rim where no guard can catch him.
Custos learns the ground before he holds it.
Aquila takes the western post; coin now, steel later.
Velox doubles his kit while the others argue over posts.
Custos stockpiles arms; the door can wait its guard.
Ictus snaps up the western cache one step from his boots.
Velox keeps moving; every stop is one more piece.
Custos walks the south road toward the door he means to hold.
Ictus breaks north; the blade work comes later.
Aquila fills his purse; two coins buy the peristyle.
Custos takes the pugio at the threshold he will defend.
Ictus takes the pilum from under Velox's nose.
Aquila pockets a helmet on his way past.
Velox sweeps the north wall clean before heading south.
Ictus races Custos for the last two caches.
Aquila trades purse-work for steel now that coin is full.
A slow step south, but Velox keeps clear of every blade.
Custos snatches the scutum before Ictus clears the corner.
Aquila takes the gladius; one coin of steel at a time.
Velox sidles down the west lane, far from the brawlers.
Custos completes his kit; the door will have its keeper.
Ictus fills his belt just behind the guard.
Velox completes the set and eyes the checkpoint.
Custos strikes the gong; the countdown to the vault begins.
Ictus shoves the runner while the walk back costs nothing.
Aquila pockets the last shield; the vault resets the board anyway.
Custos tolls the eagle before the doors even open.
Ictus mugs the runner once more; the board forgets, the purse remembers.
Aquila pockets the dagger under everyone's boots.
Twice kicked, Velox pays back the one kicker in reach.
Ictus steps out of the empty throne room toward the seals.
Aquila buys his first seal outright; coin beats dice.
Velox tests the barracks guard before anyone can bar the way.
The guard pays his toll at the peristyle like everyone else.
Aquila rolls the cellars dice for his second seal.
Velox squares up to the barracks guard again.
A kick would carry the eagle to the door; Custos takes cellars instead.
Ictus pays for the peristyle and keeps his blade money.
Velox ducks into the cellars for his second stamp.
The guard spends his coin on the Emperor himself.
No profit in kicking a man one step from his door; Ictus hunts the cellars.
Aquila provokes the guard: a win pays coin, a loss pays distance.
Kicked from his own door, Custos kicks the Emperor instead.
Ictus rolls the cellars; one stamp from the throne.
Aquila buys his swing; the vault answers in coin.
Velox learns the trick: even a lost kick lands him at the door.
Ictus bets on the fight: coin if he wins, the doorstep if he loses.
Aquila spends his last coin for the killing blow.
